description:
ATTENTION INVESTORS. A studio apartment in a block built just 5 years ago. Offering the student their own study room incorporating a personal shower room and kitchenette and with access to all communal facilities. Close to excellent transport links and within walking distance of UCLan. Call to arrange a viewing before it sells.

A studio apartment in a purpose built student block of apartments within walking distance of UCLan and with superb transport links including bus routes on the doorstep.

The complex has superb facilities including;

Reception area

Communal cinema room

Resident only gym

Garden area

Concierge service desk

CCTV

All rooms feature a double bed, Smart TV, fitted wardrobe, drawers, study desk, dining table and chairs and include ALL BILLS and high speed broadband.

The room is currently rented out until the end of the academic year providing a gross income of £8000 and a net income of £4486.

EPC rating = B

Head lease = 125 years

Service charge / management fees = Approximately 32% of rental income.

Ground rent = £275 per annum

CAN ONLY BE LET TO STUDENTS VIA MANAGEMENT COMPANY.

Please contact Kingswood.
